title: A name from the Colorado River
text: Mojave takes its name from the Mohave Indian nation, whose homeland was on the Colorado River. Mojave is the Spanish spelling of that nation's own name for itself.

s1.title: Mojave, CA (Digital-Desert)
s1.quote: The name Mojave comes from the name of the Mohave Indian nation influencing the desert area before the arrival of European settlers.

s2.quote: The word 'Mojave' is Spanish for 'Hamakhava' (or 'Hamakhaaav'), the name of the Native American nation on the Colorado River
